topic: Listing gets traffic but low conversion
problem: People visit the product page but most leave without buying.
solution: Make the page answer buyer doubts fast: clearest photo first, the main doubt answered in the title, size, use and care shown clearly, and fix what bad reviews complain about.
title: Lots of visitors, very few orders
items: Answer the main doubt in the title
Show size, use and care clearly
Fix what bad reviews complain about

problem: Best sellers run out of stock in the middle of a sale and sales stop.
solution: Plan stock from last sale's daily sales, send stock early, pause ads when stock runs low, and set reorder alerts for best sellers.
title: Stock ran out in the middle of a sale
items: Check daily sales from your last sale
Pause ads when stock runs low
Set a reorder alert for best sellers

problem: Ad spend keeps rising but profit does not grow.
solution: Work out true profit after fees and returns, cut search terms that never sell, move budget to products that make money, and track profit instead of only sales.
title: Ad spend is up but profit is flat
items: Work out profit after fees and returns
Cut search terms that never sell
Move budget to products that make money
line: MarketOps can help you see where the money goes.
